analyst.summary: JSW Dulux is the former Akzo Nobel India, recently taken over by JSW Paints (JSW Group) and renamed accordingly. The headline FY26 profit figure is dominated - roughly 98% of it - by a large one-time other-income item tied to the ownership transition, not ongoing paint sales, and once that is set aside the core business has actually been shrinking (sales down 12% over the trailing year, declining for three years running). The balance sheet is debt-free and the new owner is well-capitalized and ambitious in the paints category, but the current numbers do not yet show a turnaround. We rate it a Hold and flag the earnings-quality distortion for the portfolio manager's review.
